name: Cogeneration and combined heat and power
aliases: Cogeneration and combined heat and power
principle: A prime mover (gas turbine, reciprocating engine or boiler with steam turbine) makes electricity while its waste heat is recovered as steam or hot water for a process or building. US EPA reports total CHP efficiencies of 65 to 80% and sometimes close to 90%, against 50 to 55% for separate heat and grid power.

process_steps.name: Heat recovery from exhaust and jacket
Steam or hot water to process, absorption chiller or district heat

key_equipment: heat recovery steam generator or exhaust boiler
